'''Malisan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] working as a [[Nerf herder/Legends|nerf herder]] for [[Seth Horgon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He killed Seth when he refused to sell his indenture to [[Alchibi Des]].<ref name="Far Horizons" />
